INSERT INTO task_comments (task_id, content, user_id, commenter_type, commenter_id, comment_type, status, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{commenterType}, #{commenterId}, #{commentType}, #{status}, datetime('now','localtime'))
